During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] '''attacked''' the [[Lord Nefarid's hideout|hideout]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Nefarid]] in order to stop the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] from massacring innocents with the stolen [[Death Mark laser]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. After witnessing the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the Jedi's former teacher [[Orgus Din]] at the hands of Nefarid's master [[Darth Angral]], the Knight defeated Nefarid in battle and used the Death Mark laser to target and destroy the weapon's own targeting computer.
